summary: Thomas Heffernan, born about 1736 in Tipperary, Ireland, once placed as father of Patrick Heffernan; the link to John's line has been disproven.
bio: Thomas Heffernan was born about 1736 in Tipperary, Ireland. He was at one time recorded as the father of Patrick Heffernan, but no record supports the connection, and he is no longer regarded as one of John's ancestors.
sources: Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)
